content.text: The iconic scene where Del Boy falls through the bar in "Only Fools and Horses" happens in the episode **"Yuppy Love"**, which is the first episode of Series 6. The episode originally aired on 8th January 1989. In this scene, Del Boy is trying to impress women by leaning against the bar, but the bar flap is open, and he falls straight through. This moment is widely regarded as one of the funniest in British sitcom history
